hardware_revision: dual-camera-neck-mount v4, local hardware working tree dated 2026-10-21
cad_frame: millimeters, +X lateral, +Y rear, +Z up; native coordinates retained

registration.status: nominal socket fit, not physically calibrated
registration.basis: CAD foot bottom placed on the torso mesh central horizontal ledge at Z=303.899 mm. Neck axis X=13.5 mm is the midpoint of its X=2..25 mm span; Y=0. Photos establish upright, front/back orientation only. Seating depth and registration require measurement.

optical_model.status: ideal equidistant, not calibrated to the physical cameras
optical_model.site_frame: MuJoCo/OpenGL: +X image right, +Y image up, -Z optical forward
optical_model.pupil_basis: Centered on the CAD cover opening; 7 mm outward from the holder face, 2 mm beyond the cover. Axial position, actual lens model, sensor crop and distortion are unmeasured.
optical_model.renderer: examples/render_fixed_cameras.py; six coincident 90-degree views, reprojected onto a 200-degree circular image

dynamics.inertia_method: Uniform 50 x 126.2 x 88.5 mm bounding box, center near CAD mesh centroid
dynamics.collisions: Conservative neck, bridge and camera-box primitives, not connector-level contact geometry

limits: Original body25 torso and limbs are retained, including torso shell geometry not present in the installation photos.
Printed mount and both covers use the exact v4 native-coordinate meshes; board and lens visuals are nominal primitives.
No claim of real-camera pixel accuracy, calibration, cable occlusion, physical clearance or load qualification.
